item.title: Canadá: el independentismo gana en Quebec y reabre la puerta a un referéndum de separación
item.description: La provincia canadiense de Quebec vuelve a poner sobre la mesa el debate sobre la independencia. El partido soberanista Parti Québécois (PQ) ganó las elecciones provinciales y su líder, Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, se perfila como próximo primer ministro de la región. Durante la campaña, prometió impulsar un nuevo referéndum sobre la separación de Quebec de Canadá, argumentando que la independencia es clave para preservar la identidad francófona de la provincia. item.title: 'They Stole a City' author Lauren Collins on how Wilmington coup was 'covered up'
item.description: The author of a new book that tells the story of a White supremacist coup in her hometown of Wilmington, North Carolina has spoken to FRANCE 24 about how those involved and the authorities covered up the event for years. item.title: Mexico makes push for fracking despite environmental concerns
item.description: Following months of consultations with energy experts, Mexico is preparing to tap its shale oil and gas reserves using one of the world's most controversial extraction techniques: fracking. The process is already used to extract oil in the southeastern state of Veracruz, where local communities have long complained of pollution and environmental damage. But the administration of President Claudia Sheinbaum is seeking to reduce Mexico's reliance on the United States and – eventually – achieve energy self-sufficiency. FRANCE 24's Quentin Duval and Laurence Cuvillier report. Fuente: France 24 - English.
